observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== search ALL ruby files for the terms_data/accept definitions ==="; grep -rn "terms_data_protection\|terms_data_storage\|terms_general\|resource_terms" --include="*.rb" . 2>/dev/null | grep -i "attr_\|def \|attribute \|include\|module\|extend" | head; echo "=== check concerns included in user ==="; grep -rn "include " app/models/concerns/verification.rb app/models/user.rb 2>/dev/null | grep -i "term\|gdpr\|privacy" ; echo "=== is there a Terms module? ==="; find . -iname "*term*" -name "*.rb" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -v locales
